heading: EXT. SALT-WORKS BOILING SHED - ABANDONED TERRITORY - DAY

units.text: EXT. SALT-WORKS BOILING SHED - ABANDONED TERRITORY - DAY
Wind-scoured plank walls.
Iron evaporation pans crusted white.
A lone RIDER (40s, flour-sack coat, hat pulled low) leads a lame horse through the doorway and ties it to a post.
He paces the shed, reading the walls.
A faded wanted poster flaps from a nail.
He tears it free and studies it.
Jedediah Strake. Five hundred dollars. Dead or alive.
units.name: RIDER

units.text: He folds the poster into his coat.
The scrape of a boot outside.
He stops.
Hand to his holster.
Whoever's there, I've got a crooked horse and a straight gun.
units.name: RIDER

units.text: Silence.
Wind.
Then a voice, thin and tinny, from the saddlebag.
He stares at it.
Jed. If you're hearing this, you've gone back to the salt.
units.name: RADIO
paren: through static, his own recorded voice

units.text: He pulls a battered wax cylinder player from the bag, cranks it, and holds it up.
Don't stay past dark. The pans remember.
units.name: JEDEDIAH

units.text: Jedediah sets the player down.
The horse whinnies.
Outside, the sun drops behind the ridge, and the white pans turn gray, then blue, then slowly begin to glow.
Well, I never did listen to myself.
units.name: JEDEDIAH

units.text: He draws his pistol and steps out to meet the light.
